Phone visitors: send the link to the computer

Proposal for the download block shown to phone readers inside guides. The phone screens are real captures: "Today" is the live site, "Proposed" is the working component in an unpublished branch. Tap the buttons inside the phone.

Why change it (last 30 days)

  • 5,476phone visitors, 14% of all traffic
  • 0.64%of guide block views end in an email: 26 of 4,080
  • 13.6%on the home download section: 15 of 110
  • 46%of people who get the email request an installer: 18 of 39

The email works once it is sent. The loss is the step before: a reader who came for pricing will not type an email address. The home figure shows the same form converts when the visitor is already looking for the download.

What changes

  • The main button opens the phone's own share sheet with the download link. One tap, nothing to type. The reader sends it to their computer through AirDrop, a chat with themselves, notes or mail.
  • The email form stays, one tap away under "Or email it to me". Its copy, validation, errors and success state are unchanged.
  • Phones and in-app browsers without a share sheet keep today's form.
  • Only the compact block inside guides changes. The home download section keeps the email form, where 13.6% of viewers use it.
  • English and Spanish copy.

How we will know

SignalWhere
Taps on the share buttonmobile_share_click
Share completed, not cancelledmobile_share_done
Installer requests from the shared linkthe link carries ?source=mobile_share
Emails, as todaymobile_link_submit

Compare 14 complete days after release with the 14 before. Success: phone visitors who share or submit rise from 0.7% to 3% or more, with email submissions not falling in absolute numbers.

Not known yet: how many shared links are opened on a computer. That is the number this test produces. A shared link also leaves us no email address.
